lines.trans: A whole hour has passed already!
So what? This is complex work.
You are taking very long to fix my tank.
Do you think this is done in fifteen minutes?
This is sophisticated modern equipment!
I took it apart myself before.
One thing is you, another is a grown adult.
Does it hurt you here?
No, it just tickles.
Why are you hovering over me?
Uncle Arkady will fix everything and call you.
Go into the room and don't get in the way!
